words.definition: an activity that you do for fun in your free time
words.example: Painting is my favorite hobby.

words.definition: time when you are not working or studying
words.example: I play football in my free time.

words.definition: to rest and stop worrying
words.example: I relax by listening to music.

words.definition: to look at words and understand their meaning
words.example: I read a book every night.

words.definition: a set of printed pages with a story or information, joined together
words.example: This book is very interesting.

words.definition: to make words on paper with a pen or pencil
words.example: She likes to write short stories.

words.definition: sounds made by singing or by instruments
words.example: He listens to music on the bus.

words.definition: to pay attention to a sound
words.example: I listen to the radio every morning.

words.definition: a short piece of music with words
words.example: This is my favorite song.

words.definition: to do an activity for fun
words.example: Children play in the park.

words.definition: an activity with rules that people play for fun
words.example: We play a card game together.

words.definition: to make a picture using a pencil or pen
words.example: My son can draw very well.

words.definition: an image made by drawing, painting, or photography
words.example: She painted a beautiful picture.

words.definition: to move your body to music
words.example: We dance at every party.

words.definition: to make music with your voice
words.example: She likes to sing in the shower.

words.definition: to look at something for some time
words.example: We watch movies on Friday night.

words.definition: a story shown on a screen with moving pictures
words.example: This movie is very funny.

words.definition: to get and keep many of the same kind of thing
words.example: He likes to collect stamps.

words.definition: a machine used to take photographs
words.example: She takes photos with her camera.

words.definition: a game for two players with a board and small pieces
words.example: My grandfather taught me to play chess.

text: Everyone needs a hobby for their free time. After school, I like to relax and do fun things. My favorite hobby is reading. I read a new book every week. My sister likes music. She listens to songs on her phone and sometimes she can sing very well. My brother likes to draw. He can draw a good picture of our house. On weekends, my family likes to play games together. We often play chess, and my father always wins. My friend has a different hobby: she likes to dance. She dances every Saturday at a small club. My mother likes to watch movies. We watch a movie together every Friday night. My uncle likes to collect old coins and stamps. He also has a camera, and he takes pictures of birds in the garden. Everyone in my family has a different hobby, but we all enjoy our free time in our own way. Hobbies make us happy.
